div.div: سَكْبِينَجٌ an arabicized word [from the Pers. سَكْبِينَهٌ]; (O;) [Sagapenum;] a certain medicine, (O, K,) well-known; (K;) the gum of a certain tree (O, TA) in Persia, (TA,) [supposed to be the ferula Persica,] in which is no useful property, but only in its gum: some say that there is a sort of قِنَّة [or galbanum] that changes from its original state and becomes سكبينج. (O.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
